name: conference.Countdown
summary: How long until a moment a person is waiting for (the doors opening, a ticket sale closing): the words, then the time left in days and hours, or hours and minutes on the last day, in the reader's language. Once the moment passes it says `passed` instead. A Conference template part (Q64): it lives only in this template's scope. Not for a timer a person starts and stops, or for a length of time that's already known (write it as text).
a11y: The time left is a `<time>` whose `datetime` is the moment itself, so assistive technology can read the exact date. It updates once a minute and is never announced, so it doesn't interrupt a screen reader.

props.name: label
props.description: What the time counts to, before the figure: "Doors open in".

props.name: until
props.description: The moment, as an ISO date and time with its offset: "2027-03-11T09:00:00+00:00".

props.name: passed

props.description: Count from this moment instead of the clock (stories and screenshots stay the same).
